  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "Place the {{ing_01|fish}} in sauce pan, add {{ing_02|broth}} {{ing_03|oil}} and {{ing_04|wine}} (and poach it)."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "Also finely chop {{ing_05|leek heads (the white part only of leeks)}} and {{ing_06|(fresh) coriander}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "(When cool, mince the {{ing_01|fish}} fine) form it into small cakes adding {{ing_07|capers}} and {{ing_08|sea-nettles well cleaned}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "These fish cakes cook in a liquor of {{ing_09|pepper}}, {{ing_10|lovage}} and {{ing_11|origany}}, crushed, diluted with {{ing_02|broth}} and the above fish liquor which skim well, bind (with roux or eggs) stir (strain) over the cakes, sprinkle with {{ing_09|pepper}} and serve."
